title: ProjeXus
desc: Project-competition management platform for ICTI Michoacán, with QR-verified certificates.
highlights: Google OAuth 2.0 sign-in and reCAPTCHA on registration
PDF recognitions with QR generation and verification
Participant, judge and admin dashboards in Next.js

title: Adopciones CAAM
desc: Animal adoption registration, tracking and veterinary scheduling for the Centro de Atención Animal de Morelia.
highlights: Auth with Better Auth: Google and GitHub sign-in
Adoption and vet-appointment emails, verification flow
CI workflows, Docker deployment and unit tests

title: Alvare Ditana
desc: Website for a café in Acámbaro, Guanajuato: menu, shop, directions and reviews, written in Spanish.
highlights: Menu, shop, directions and reviews sections
SEO: structured data (JSON-LD) and page metadata
Animated hero and gallery with Motion

title: Gestor CFDI
desc: Web app for accounting firms: reads and validates CFDI invoices and suggests classifications; the accountant approves.
highlights: CFDI 4.0 reading, upload and SAT verification
Client classification by firm into preset categories
Database schema, user management and sprint plan

title: RutaSegura ITM
desc: Public-transport web app for Morelia: live route map, trip planner with ETAs, crowding reports and an operator panel.
highlights: Interactive map: routes, stops, ETA bubbles, dark mode
Trip planner: nearest route, walking leg and ETA
Operator panel with unit simulator and incidents
